parameters.query:
MATCH (p:Performance) WHERE NOT (p)--() WITH count(p) AS perfs_iso
MATCH (m:Match)       WHERE NOT (m)--() WITH perfs_iso, count(m) AS matchs_iso
MATCH (j:Joueur)      WHERE NOT (j)--() WITH perfs_iso, matchs_iso, count(j) AS joueurs_iso
RETURN perfs_iso, matchs_iso, joueurs_iso,
       (perfs_iso + matchs_iso + joueurs_iso) AS total_iso,
       CASE WHEN (perfs_iso + matchs_iso + joueurs_iso) = 0 THEN 'OK' ELSE 'ECHEC' END AS statut

MATCH (m:Match)
WHERE m.score_home IS NOT NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (dom:Equipe)-[:DISPUTE]->(m)
OPTIONAL MATCH (vis:Equipe)-[:VISITE]->(m)
OPTIONAL MATCH (:Saison)-[:CONTIENT]->(m)
WITH m,
     count(DISTINCT dom) AS nb_dom,
     count(DISTINCT vis) AS nb_vis
WHERE nb_dom <> 1 OR nb_vis <> 1
RETURN count(m) AS matchs_incomplets,
       CASE WHEN count(m) = 0 THEN 'OK' ELSE 'ECHEC' END AS statut

MATCH (p:Performance)
WHERE (p.fgm IS NOT NULL AND p.fga IS NOT NULL AND p.fgm > p.fga)
   OR (p.fg3m IS NOT NULL AND p.fg3a IS NOT NULL AND p.fg3m > p.fg3a)
   OR (p.ftm IS NOT NULL AND p.fta IS NOT NULL AND p.ftm > p.fta)
RETURN count(p) AS stats_invalides,
       CASE WHEN count(p) = 0 THEN 'OK' ELSE 'ECHEC' END AS statut

MATCH (j:Joueur)-[r:JOUE_POUR {actif: true}]->(e:Equipe)
WITH j, count(r) AS nb
WHERE nb > 1
RETURN count(j) AS joueurs_conflits,
       CASE WHEN count(j) = 0 THEN 'OK' ELSE 'ECHEC' END AS statut

MATCH (j:Joueur)      WITH count(j) AS nb_joueurs
MATCH (e:Equipe)      WITH nb_joueurs, count(e) AS nb_equipes
MATCH (m:Match)       WITH nb_joueurs, nb_equipes, count(m) AS nb_matchs
MATCH (p:Performance) WITH nb_joueurs, nb_equipes, nb_matchs, count(p) AS nb_perfs
MATCH (c:Classement)  WITH nb_joueurs, nb_equipes, nb_matchs, nb_perfs, count(c) AS nb_class
MATCH ()-[r]->()      WITH nb_joueurs, nb_equipes, nb_matchs, nb_perfs, nb_class, count(r) AS nb_rels
RETURN nb_joueurs, nb_equipes, nb_matchs, nb_perfs, nb_class, nb_rels

// Réparer les relations LORS_DE manquantes
MATCH (p:Performance)
WHERE NOT (p)-[:LORS_DE]->(:Match) AND p.match_id IS NOT NULL
MATCH (m:Match {id: p.match_id})
MERGE (p)-[:LORS_DE]->(m)
WITH count(*) AS rep_lors_de

// Réparer les relations REALISE manquantes
MATCH (p:Performance)
WHERE NOT (:Joueur)-[:REALISE]->(p) AND p.joueur_id IS NOT NULL
MATCH (j:Joueur {id: p.joueur_id})
MERGE (j)-[:REALISE]->(p)
WITH rep_lors_de, count(*) AS rep_realise

// Réparer les relations POUR_EQUIPE manquantes
MATCH (p:Performance)
WHERE NOT (p)-[:POUR_EQUIPE]->(:Equipe) AND p.equipe_id IS NOT NULL
MATCH (e:Equipe {id: p.equipe_id})
MERGE (p)-[:POUR_EQUIPE]->(e)

RETURN rep_lors_de, rep_realise, 'reparations_effectuees' AS statut
